heroHeadline: Russia's Largest Multi-Weapon Barrage: 731 Missiles & Drones Demolish Kyiv Apartment Block — 7 Killed; Kremlin Rejects Peace Talks
heroSubtitle: Russia launched 731 aerial assets overnight May 13–14 — 675 Shaheds, 35 Kh-101 cruise missiles, 18 Iskander-M ballistics, and 3 Kinzhal hypersonics — the most diverse single-wave attack of the war and part of a 30-hour, 1,560+ total drone-and-missile campaign. A residential apartment block in Kyiv was demolished: at least 7 killed, 11 rescued from rubble, 33 injured including a 2-month-old infant. Ukraine's air defenses destroyed 693 of 731 assets. On the ground, 187 combat engagements were recorded — the Pokrovsk and Huliaipole sectors faced ~50 Russian assault attempts each. Russian cumulative losses reached ~1,345,240, with 1,060 killed or wounded in the last 24 hours alone. Ukraine retaliated with deep strikes into Russia, where the Russian MoD claims 286 Ukrainian drones were intercepted across 14 regions; 1 man was killed in Belgorod. Diplomatically, Kremlin spokesman Peskov demanded a 'ceasefire first' framework — rejected by Kyiv — while Zelensky declared: 'These are not the actions of those who believe the war is coming to an end.' CNN analysis concluded: 'Russia's winning streak in Ukraine is over.'
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, France 24, NPR, CNN, and Euronews. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
